desc: Increases the damage of your poison effects by % against enemies above 50% health.

desc: Damage taken reduced by %.

desc: Reduces the duration of all poison effects used on you by %, and reduces all periodic Magic damage taken by %. Lasts.

desc: Increases the damage of Blight Venom by %.

desc: Increases the damage and healing of Serpent's Coil by %. Critical heals with Alkahest now reduce the cooldown of Serpent's Coil by sec.

desc: Reduces the cost of all spells and abilities by %.

desc: Shapeshift into a Venom Spitter, increasing your movement speed by %, allowing you to hover, and slowing your falling speed. While falling, you can control your direction and will slowly descend downwards. Can only be used outdoors.

desc: Blast an enemy with a jet of toxic venom, dealing its value Shadow Damage, increasing the damage the target takes from this spell by % and its mana cost by %, stacks times. your target is afflicted with Lethargy, this spell incurs no cooldown. Usable while moving. Scales with modif

desc: Reduce all damage taken while in Beetle Form by -3% and increases your movement speed while in Spider Form by 5%. (up to 2 ranks)

name: Vile Fury
desc: Vile Stinger generates Rage and the cost of Hivebreak is reduced.

name: Vile Sting
desc: Taunts an enemy target to attack you. the target is tauntable and not currently targeting you, you trigger your current Venoms.

name: Vileburst
desc: Increases the damage of Withering Venom by % on enemies above 75% health.

name: Virulent Opening
desc: Increases the periodic damage dealt by your Facemelter and Rotfang by % while above 75% health.

name: Virulent Resonance
desc: Increases the effectiveness of Brood Marks by % and your hit chance by %.

name: Vulnerability
desc: Level 40 Passive While Blight Venom is active, your auto attacks now have a % chance to apply it. In addition, your offensive critical strikes now increase the target's spell damage taken by %.

name: Wasp Form
desc: Shapeshift into Wasp Form, increasing movement speed by % and allowing you to fly. Can only shapeshift into Wasp Form in Outland or Northrend, and cannot be used in Combat.

name: Weakening Venom
desc: Activate Weakening Venom, giving your casts a % chance to deal its value Shadow damage and reduce an enemy's attack power by its value. You can have a maximum of 2 unique Venoms active at a time.

name: Weaver Form
desc: Level 30 Passive Teaches you Weaver Form.

name: Web Wrap
desc: Wrap your target in a cocoon, stunning them.

name: Wicked Poison
desc: Critical strikes with Chitin Rush, Carapace Crash, and Hivebreak now apply Wicked Poison.

desc: Requires Spider Form Consumes Brood Marks Inject shadow venom into an enemy, dealing Shadow damage and reducing their healing received by 50%. 1 Mark: its value Shadow damage. 2 Marks: its value Shadow damage. 3 Marks: {(35+spell power)

desc: Wilt the life of an enemy with vile poison, dealing Nature damage over.

name: Withering Venom
desc: Inject an enemy with a devastating venom, dealing its value Nature damage every sec. Damage is dealt slowly at first, and builds up over time.

name: Worship
desc: Allows all critical heals to increase periodic healing the target receives from you by %.
